# Kids in the House

> A comprehensive parenting resource platform offering 8,000+ expert videos, curated playlists, live streaming, and community forums across all parenting styles and child development topics.

Kids in the House connects parents with 450+ parenting experts and professionals through video content, live discussions, articles, and peer-to-peer forums. The platform serves as both an educational resource and community hub for family wellness guidance.

## Core Platform

- [Kids in the House](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com): Homepage with 8,000+ parenting videos from 450 experts
- [Parenting Experts](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com/experts): Directory of 450 parenting experts and professionals
- [Top Videos](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com/playlists): Curated video playlists on pregnancy, child development, and parenting
- [Latest Articles](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com/articles): Index of latest parenting articles and family wellness content

## Community & Engagement

- [Parent-to-Parent Forums](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com/forum): Community forums for peer support and parenting discussions
- [LiveTV Episodes](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com/livetv/previous-episodes): Archive of live streaming episodes with expert discussions

## User Accounts & Premium

- [Create Account](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com/kith-register/nojs/choice): User registration and account creation page
- [Premium](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com/premium): Premium subscription with guides, live streams, and expert advice

## About & Company Information

- [About Us](https://www.kidsinthehouse.com/about-us): Company overview featuring founder mission and expert testimonials
